items.followUp: Name two other careers in biology and state what each involves.

rubric.why: Checks the role of medicine as a career using biological knowledge.
rubric.description: Medicine uses biological knowledge to diagnose, prevent or treat disease.

rubric.why: Checks the distinct role of surgery.
rubric.description: Surgery treats diseases or injuries by performing operations.
Horticulture is the cultivation and improvement of plants.

rubric.why: Checks an example or purpose of horticulture.
rubric.description: Horticulture includes growing useful plants such as fruits, vegetables and ornamental plants, and improving their growth and quality.
rubric.how: Give an example or purpose of horticulture.

modelAnswer: Medicine applies biological knowledge to diagnose, prevent and treat diseases.
Surgery treats diseases or injuries by performing operations on the body.
Horticulture is the cultivation and improvement of plants.
Horticulturists grow and improve useful plants, including fruits, vegetables and ornamental plants.

items.followUp: Name the two main compound tissues in plants and state what each transports.

rubric.why: Checks the definition of a compound tissue.
rubric.description: A compound tissue consists of different kinds of cells that work together to perform a common function.
rubric.how: Define a compound tissue by its cell composition and shared function.

rubric.description: Xylem conducts water and mineral salts.
Xylem consists of vessels, tracheids, fibres and parenchyma.
rubric.how: Name the cell types that make up xylem.

rubric.why: Checks the function and components of phloem.
rubric.description: Phloem transports prepared food and consists of sieve tubes, companion cells, fibres and parenchyma.
rubric.how: Name what phloem transports and its constituent cell types.

modelAnswer: A compound tissue is made of different kinds of cells that work together to perform a common function.
Xylem and phloem are the compound tissues found in vascular plants.
Xylem consists of vessels, tracheids, fibres and parenchyma; it conducts water and mineral salts.
Phloem consists of sieve tubes, companion cells, fibres and parenchyma; it transports prepared food through the plant.

items.followUp: Describe the lock-and-key model of enzyme action.

rubric.why: Checks that the enzyme has a specifically shaped active site.
rubric.description: Each enzyme has an active site with a particular shape.

rubric.why: Checks the specific fit between the substrate and the active site.
rubric.description: A complementary substrate binds to the enzyme's active site.

rubric.why: Checks the intermediate stage of enzyme action.
rubric.how: Name the complex formed when the substrate binds.

rubric.why: Checks product release and that the enzyme can be reused.
rubric.description: Products leave the active site, while the enzyme remains unchanged and can be used again.
rubric.how: State what happens to the products and enzyme after the reaction.

modelAnswer: Each enzyme has an active site with a particular shape.
A complementary substrate binds to the active site, forming an enzyme-substrate complex.
The enzyme catalyses the reaction and converts the substrate into product(s).
The products leave the active site, while the enzyme remains unchanged and can be used again.

items.followUp: Explain why a farmer should replace mineral nutrients removed from soil by crops.

rubric.why: Checks that fertilizers supply nutrients required by plants.
rubric.description: Fertilizers supply essential mineral nutrients needed for plant growth.

rubric.why: Checks the role of fertilizers in restoring soil nutrients.
rubric.description: Fertilizers replace nutrients removed from the soil by crops and help maintain soil fertility.
rubric.how: Explain how fertilizers restore soil fertility.

rubric.why: Checks the effect of adequate mineral nutrition on plants.
rubric.description: Adequate mineral nutrition promotes healthy plant growth and development.
rubric.how: Link mineral nutrients with plant growth.

rubric.why: Checks the agricultural benefit of suitable fertilizer use.
rubric.description: Suitable fertilizers can increase crop yield and food production.
rubric.how: State the effect of suitable fertilizer use on production.

modelAnswer: Fertilizers supply essential mineral nutrients required for plant growth.
They replace nutrients that crops have removed from the soil and help maintain soil fertility.
Adequate mineral nutrition promotes healthy growth and development.
Using suitable fertilizers can increase crop yield and food production.
